sarah.csm: Heads up — AuroraPay just sent a bespoke SIG/CAIQ with a few custom sections. They want answers for KMS/HSM attestation, audit-log exportability, and precise retention windows. Due Friday EOD per their email. I attached the form: https://secure.mail/aurora/sig-form.pdf. Can security + eng help with precise answers and an audit export sample? :alarm_clock:

luke.support: Copy. Do we have our previous responses? I remember they asked about 365d retention last time.

emily.security: I'm on it. Need clarification on two bespoke asks: 1) "logical separation of keys" — do they mean tenant key isolation vs. customer-managed CMKs? 2) exact HSM vendor/type for attestation (they asked for FIPS level). Can someone confirm our HSM configuration and whether we can provide an attestation? Also they want a 90-day audit export sample.

raj.eng: For audit exports we can produce an NDJSON dump. Quick command I use for exports (internal tool):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/export?customer=aurora&from=2025-12-01&to=2026-03-01\" -o aurora_audit.ndjson
```
This will include event_type, timestamp, actor, resource, and metadata. Note: we'll scrub PII and IPs before handing to customers. Platform default audit retention is 180 days.

deploy-bot: Export job 98765 queued by raj.eng at 1777655000.

sarah.csm: @raj please run and upload a sanitized sample to the secure share. @emily can you draft suggested SIG answers? We need to hand the draft to legal 24–48h before Friday.

raj.eng: Starting the export now. ETA ~2h. I'll scrub IPs and customer identifiers, then upload to secure share: https://files.redwood.example/s/aurora-audit-sample (private link).

deploy-bot: Export job 98765 started by raj.eng at 1777655222. Status: running.

luke.support: FYI Aurora mentioned intermittent 503s in February and asked whether the audit logs show any cascade failures. If we can produce the 90-day trace and a note on retention that'd help their IT team.

emily.security: Drafting answers now. Quick facts to align on before I finalize: 1) KMS + HSM: we use AWS KMS backed by CloudHSM for tenant root keys; customers may bring their own CMKs via external key material in KMS for Private deployments. 2) Rotation: default key rotation policy is annual; ad-hoc rotations supported for enterprise. 3) Audit logs: platform audit logs retained 180 days; per-customer exports available for 90 days standard unless extended via contract. 4) Attestation: we can provide SOC2 + HSM vendor attestation letter — legal needs to sign off on distribution.

anita.pmo: Deadline note: Aurora's email lists Friday 2026-03-20 EOD as the due date. Can we realistically deliver a legal-reviewed draft by Thu EOD? Legal usually wants 24h.

raj.eng: Export finished, scrubbed, and uploaded. File: aurora_audit_sample_1777655123.ndjson (shared to emily + sarah only). I removed IPs, replaced with <REDACTED_IP>, and hashed customer IDs.

emily.security: Received sample, thanks. Draft below — please review and flag any inaccuracies before I hand to legal: 

```
SIG/CAIQ draft answers (short):
1) KMS/HSM: Customer keys are stored in AWS KMS. We use AWS CloudHSM as the HSM backing for root/tenant keys in our hosted offering. For Private deployments, customers can use customer-managed CMKs or their own HSMs.
2) Key separation: Keys are logically separated by tenant. Customer-managed keys (CMKs) give additional separation and control.
3) Rotation and policy: Default rotation is 12 months. Emergency rotation supported via support escalation.
4) Audit logs: Platform audit logs are retained for 180 days. Per-customer exports are available on request (standard export coverage: 90 days) and can be extended under contract.
5) Attestation: We can provide SOC2 reports and an HSM attestation letter from the HSM vendor on request; legal will coordinate release.
```

luke.support: :eyes: Small nit — request logs (application request/trace logs) default retention differs by plan: hosted default 30 days, enterprise 90. Might be worth surfacing both numbers explicitly in the SIG.

emily.security: Good call. Updating that section now. Updated draft: "request logs retention: hosted 30 days, enterprise 90 days; audit logs 180 days; exports 90 days standard."

tim.product: Noted. Legal asked for 24h to review after we submit. We can meet that if draft is to legal by Thu EOD.

sarah.csm: I'll submit the updated draft to legal and attach the sanitized export. Plan: submit now as "draft for legal review", ask legal to sign attestation request if needed, then send final to Aurora. I'll update this thread when legal replies. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
